name: Sitelets for Multisite
author: Ralph Massetti

sections.description:
Take control of branding, content, and local flexibility for your WordPress Multisite deployment—all from one centralized dashboard. Whether your organization manages 2 or 2,000 subsites (“Sitelets”), this plugin gives you end-to-end control without the chaos.

Manage Your WordPress Multisite System with One Click

Don’t struggle with thousands of web pages and hundreds of subsites. With Sitelets for Multisite, you gain effortless content and branding control from a centralized dashboard. Whether your organization has 2 or 2,000 subsites, this plugin provides the end-to-end governance you need.

Core Features

  • Centralized Brand Control: Lock down branding elements (logos, colors, fonts) at network level—ensuring uniformity across all Sitelets.
  • Local Content Flexibility: Let individual Sitelet admins customize specific content while maintaining the approved brand framework.
  • Instant, Network‑Wide Updates: Push content or branding changes to all Sitelets with a single click—no need to manually edit each site.
  • Built-In Local SEO Optimization: Each Sitelet is SEO‑ready with location-specific metadata and structure optimized out‑of‑the‑box.
  • Compatibility with Top Plugins & Themes: Fully tested to play nicely with leading WordPress tools, Elementor, and other third-party integrations.

Want More Power? Sitelets PRO (Enterprise)

License Overview Suitable for:

  • Managing 6–10 Sitelets at $75/month, or scaling to 26–50+ Sitelets (e.g. $475/month for 26–50).
  • Flexible, month-to-month billing with no long-term contracts.

Core Capabilities:
– Unlimited pages, posts, admins, and users across your multisite network.
– Instant Sitelet creation and full cloning from main to sub-site to spin up new locations in seconds.
– Publish pages from main to Sitelets and issue instant updates network‑wide with one click.

Advanced Controls:
– Full page and block-level control to decide what’s editable and what stays locked down on each Sitelet.
– Granular branding, styling, and content controls so central admins can lock global styles/colors/fonts while allowing local variations in permitted areas.
– Manage media assets at both main and Sitelet levels with workflows for global-to-local images, documents, and other assets.

Maintenance and Support:
– Automatic free updates keep every subsite current without manual effort.
– Priority VIP support via phone, email, and chat included at all tiers.

Perfect for: Franchises, healthcare networks, real estate offices, or any enterprise needing consistent branding while giving local admins controlled flexibility. Global control, local customization, fast deployment, and full support included.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external API to retrieve news and blog posts from sitelets.com. No identifying user information is transmitted.

  • https://www.sitelets.com/terms-of-service/
  • https://www.sitelets.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WP Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin in the Network Admin plugins page.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Sitelets to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
What sets Sitelets apart from template‑based builders?

Instead of static templates, Sitelets gives you a master brand control panel plus localized editing rights—delivering both consistency and flexibility.

How is brand consistency enforced?

The network admin defines unchangeable brand elements. Sitelet admins can add local content within those guardrails.

Is support available?

Yes—live chat and email support are included across all plugin plans.

Plugin compatibility requirements?

Requires WordPress Multisite and Elementor (free or Pro). Needs at least one Sitelet.

How do I remove the plugin?

Simply deactivate and delete via Network Admin.
